MOST TRADERS CONFUSE BOS WITH CHoCH. HERE'S THE DIFFERENCE.
In market structure:
BOS = Break of Structure in the direction of the existing trend.
CHoCH = First structural break against the existing trend.
Example:
Uptrend breaks its previous high Bullish BOS.
Uptrend breaks its protected higher low Bearish CHoCH.
BOS suggests continuation.
CHoCH warns that the trend may be changing.
